cells.gaps: No yearly count after 2024 is held; the bulletin's figures to March 2025 are running totals. No commencement date for the Act is given. The commissioner leaves office on 16 November 2026 with a successor nominated.
cells.note: In force with a constituted authority and named sanctions (KEN-015, September 2024; KEN-053, February 2026), and an April 2025 analysis counts 51 ODPC determinations in 2024 (KEN-060), a reported year ending inside two years, so stage 5 without resting on the bulletin read under messages-for-bill 54. The 2024 count holds stage 5 only to the end of 2026.
